items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory; Albemarle is the lowest-cost lithium producer and its improved balance sheet provides downside resilience.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Lithium price is up about 67% year over year, still well below all-time highs; supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.
